A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''senator''' represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]&mdash;and presumably the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]&mdash;in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|era]] of [[Great Peace of the Republic|Great Peace]]. She was succeeded by [[Vidar Kim]] at some point between [[65 BBY/Legends|65]] and [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]].

==Biography==
The Naboo that would eventually become the representative for her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] started working her way up the political chain succeeding the former senator. The future senator, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] criticized her while living on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in his younger years. Staying on for a few years, she was succeeded by Vidar Kim.
